name: Proxy
description: Browser cookie proxy: an HTTP CONNECT proxy the AW Browser tunnels through, plus the cookie-sync API (/sync-cookies, /clear-cookies) that the aw-sync browser extensions (Chrome + iOS/Safari) push the user's real-browser cookies through, and encrypted persistence of chosen cookies in Postgres so they survive a proxy restart. aw-app-browser depends on this app for authentication.

auto_start.description: Start the proxy-server service automatically when the workspace starts.

proxy_port.description: TCP port the CONNECT-tunnel / cookie-sync HTTP server listens on. The aw-app-browser container's Chrome must be configured to tunnel through host:this-port.

browser_cdp_list_urls.description: CDP /json/list endpoints of every browser this proxy pushes/clears synced cookies into via WebSocket CDP commands (writes fan out to all of them; reads — /cookie-keys, /cookies-for, persisting a cookie — stay pinned to the first entry, the interactive browser, as the source of truth). Each is a separate Tier-2 (podman) container reachable by its own name on the shared workspace network. Override only if a target runs under a different app id/network, or to add another browser-ish app.

browser_cdp_list_url.description: Deprecated singular override, kept for back-compat with workspaces that set it before browser_cdp_list_urls existed. If set and browser_cdp_list_urls is not, this becomes the one-element effective target list. Prefer browser_cdp_list_urls.

allowed_networks.description: CIDR ranges allowed to use the CONNECT tunnel (the AW Browser container's source IP must be inside one of these). Includes RFC1918 ranges by default because on Tier-2 (podman) deployments aw-app-browser reaches this proxy from the shared podman network, not loopback — port 9124 is never published to the host, so this only ever admits containers already on that private network.

dependencies.note: No required app dependencies. aw-app-browser declares proxy as a required dependency; aw-workspace now enforces that edge at install/reconcile time.
